programme.title: Handball : Coupe de France masculine
programme.desc: Le Montpellier Handball et le HBC Nantes s'affrontent, à l'Accor Arena, pour la finale de la Coupe de France, dans une affiche de prestige. Les deux clubs se retrouvent pour la troisième fois de leur histoire en finale de cette compétition. Les deux précédentes confrontations avaient tourné à l'avantage des Nantais, vainqueurs face au MHB en 2017, puis en 2023.

programme.title: Sport 50
programme.desc: Nicolas et Julia, deux athlètes engagés, ont parcouru près de 1000 kilomètres entre Paris et Chamonix, à raison de 50 kilomètres par jour pendant 20 jours. Leur objectif : aller à la rencontre de clubs sportifs, d'associations, d'élus locaux et d'experts afin de comprendre concrètement comment le changement climatique impacte la pratique du sport et comment les acteurs du secteur s'adaptent au quo

programme.title: Fußball: 2. Bundesliga
programme.desc: Die 2. Fußball-Bundesliga ist nach der -Bundesliga die höchste Spielklasse im deutschen Männerfußball. Im heutigen fußballerischen Volksmund bezeichnet man sie auch als „Unterhaus“, während die 1. Liga „Oberhaus“ genannt wird. Etabliert wurde die 2. Bundesliga 1974, elf Jahre nach der Gründung ihrer großen Schwester. So sollte die wirtschaftliche Kluft von Profi- und Amateurbereich überwunden werd

programme.title: 勞德之家 [英/普]
programme.desc: 吉祥物袋鼠貴奇似乎在故意破壞校園,行動派新聞隊想要證明牠的清白 // 林肯設法在勞德家的繼承舊物家規中找到了漏洞,好讓自己而不是他的姊妹們得到蘿莉的舊床墊

programme.title: 勞德之家 [英/普]
programme.desc: 蘭妮與露娜不小心砸壞了爺爺的船,因為她們的觀影同好會逐漸失控 // 露西得到了為皇家樹林報撰寫原創故事的機會,卻苦於靈感枯竭

programme.title: 勞德之家 [英/普]
programme.desc: 蘭妮和卡蘿塔在為著名時裝設計師瑪麗艾拉摩斯實習時,他們的工作風格發生了衝突.

programme.title: 那個女孩是蕾蕾
programme.desc: 身為學生會會長,莎蒂負責主持晨間新聞,而蕾蕾則是作為建議專家給同學們意見.但是,當女孩們的建議引發不必要的麻煩時,同學們開始感到不滿.

programme.title: 雷霆家族: 雙生臥底
programme.desc: 菲碧和麥斯讓克洛伊的朋友們看恐怖電影並吃糖果後,倒楣鬼和茶茶的父母想見見克洛伊的父母.由於漢克和芭兒不在鎮上,麥斯和菲碧只好變身為他們來幫助克洛伊.一切進展順利,直到真正的漢克和芭兒出現.

programme.title: 超能小子亨利
programme.desc: 在好景市下方,一座休眠火山的活動,使得亨利和雷以為世界末日快到了.派珀相信她有麩質不耐症.

programme.title: 海綿寶寶 [英/普]
programme.desc: 海綿寶寶和章魚哥要外送餐點去可怕的社區,那裡到處都是亂七八糟的. // 海綿寶寶無法停止狂咬手指甲,但他也不知道原因何在!

programme.title: 海綿寶寶 [英/普]
programme.desc: 海綿寶寶清理駕訓班燈塔的時候,發現好萌的怪怪玩伴. // 比奇堡所有居民都有染上傳染性打嗝病的危險.

programme.title: 海綿寶寶 [英/普]
programme.desc: 章魚哥和泡泡魚必須容忍彼此,因為他們要一同前往沉船鎮. // 章魚哥進入了豐富想像力紙箱,必須依靠海綿寶寶和派大星的創造力才能逃離出來.

programme.title: 海綿寶寶 [英/普]
programme.desc: 皮老闆和凱倫去上舞蹈課程,飛速地晉升為第一名學生. // 因為一本魔法咒語書,海綿寶寶在蟹堡王廚房製造出混亂.

programme.title: 派大星秀 [英/普]
programme.desc: 星爸的老闆來家裡拜訪,海星家被困在情境劇裡. // 魷魚妹臥床不起,派大星必須靠自己主導節目.

programme.title: 派大星秀 [英/普]

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: In all competitions, Chelsea have won nine and lost just one of their 12 previous home games against Brighton and Hove Albion (D2), winning their last three in a row since a 1-2 reverse in April 2023.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Manchester United are winless in their last seven away Premier League matches (D2 L5) since a 3-0 win at Leicester in March. The Red Devils last had a longer run without an away win between March and October 2019 (eight games).

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Erling Haaland has scored 48 goals in 48 home Premier League appearances for Man City. The only player to hit 50 Premier League home goals in fewer than 50 appearances is Alan Shearer, who scored his 50th home goal in his 47th game.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Since their return to the competition in 2019, Aston Villa have won five of their 12 Premier League games against Arsenal (D1 L6), as many as they had in their previous 45 against the Gunners before relegation (D14 L26).

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Crystal Palace have won just one of their last 16 Premier League meetings with Liverpool (D3 L12), winning 1-0 at Anfield in April 2024. The Eagles haven’t scored more than once in any of their last 12 league games against the Reds (6 goals).

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Having won four of their first six Premier League games against Chelsea between 1996 and 2001 (L2), Sunderland have since won just three of their 26 against the Blues (D2 L21).

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Having lost just one of their first three Premier League meetings with Liverpool (W1 D1), Brentford have now lost each of their last five against the Reds.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Since doing the double over Arsenal in 2020-21, Wolves have now lost each of their last nine against the Gunners in the Premier League.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Leeds have won just one of their last nine Premier League games against Chelsea (D2 L6), though it was in their last meeting at Elland Road in August 2022 (3-0).

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26
programme.desc: Manchester City have won 16 of their last 19 Premier League home games (D2 L1), at least three more than any other side since April 2025.

programme.title: Premier League 2025/26

programme.title: College Football

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The unbeaten No. 3 Aggies face the No. 16 Longhorns in a Lone Star Showdown tilt. Texas A&M finds itself in the driver's seat for both an SEC title-game appearance and College Football Playoff berth after starting 11-0 for the first time since 1992.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: A heavyweight bout in the SEC sees the No. 15 Volunteers (2-0) hosting the No. 6 Bulldogs (2-0). Georgia's 31-17 victory last season was its eighth in a row over Tennessee. Bulldogs tight end Oscar Delp had a pair of TD catches in the 2024 win.

programme.desc: The No. 10 Bulldogs face the Tigers for the 130th time. Georgia leads the Deep South's Oldest Rivalry 65-56-8 after collecting an eighth straight series victory in 2024. Gunner Stockton created three TDs when Georgia thumped Kentucky 35-14 on Oct. 4.

programme.desc: A storied rivalry sees No. 5 Georgia take on Florida in Jacksonville, Fla. The Bulldogs lead the all-time series 57-44-2, and won each the past four meetings by double-digit margins. Georgia comes off a 43-35 win over then-No. 5 Ole Miss on Oct. 18.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: No. 5 Georgia (7-1, 5-1) tries to maintain its grip on Mississippi State (5-4, 1-4) in an SEC battle of Bulldogs. Georgia has won five straight meetings, and 14 of the last 15. Mississippi State rallied for a 38-35 victory at Arkansas last week.
